senses.gloss: ch. sameto split, burst, break into.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 105a:12">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>חזא צינורא דבדקא וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>דבידקא</he>) he saw that a sewer had burst into his field (inundating it); v. <cite ref="B00158"><he>בִּדְקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 65a:7">Yeb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיבְדוֹק נפשאי</he> I will test myself (as to my virility).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 2:3:2">Y. Ned. II, 37ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בעי חיפה מִיבְדְּקוּנֵיה</he> Ḥefa wanted to sound his knowledge.

senses.gloss: to cure the body by means of a purgative.
units: Ned. 50ᵇ הוה בָּדִיק נפשיה וכ׳ purged himself with &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. בְּדִיק tested, sure, known.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:5:6">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לא הוות בדיקה לי</he> was unknown to me (I had not experienced).
Taan. 23ᵇ לא בדיקתו לי (not בדקיתו) ye are unknown to me (as to your honesty).—בְּדִיקְנָא I am sure, I know.

<cite ref="Pesachim 111b:7">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>בדיקנא ביה במר דלא וכ׳</he> I am sure you do not know (Ms. M. <he>ב׳ ליה וכ׳</he>, Ms. 2 Oxf. <he>בקינא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). *<cite ref="Chullin 32a:7">Ḥull. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הוה בדיקנא ביה וכ׳</he> Ar. Var. (ed. <he>בדיחנא</he>) I was not so familiar with my uncle that I should have asked him.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 44:5">Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 44:15">15</cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="B00148"><he>בְּדִיקְנָאָה</he></cite>.
